_notes: How the narrator performs each line. Only used on models that take direction (eleven_v3, eleven_v4); older models get the plain line. `lines` maps a line's exact on-screen text to what is sent to ElevenLabs: [audio tags] for emotion and delivery (they carry forward until the next tag), ... for a pause, a dash for a beat, CAPITALS for emphasis. The words must stay the same as the plain line (generate-audio checks this), so only the delivery changes and the manifest key stays the plain text. A line without an entry gets its role's tag in front: question, correct, wrong, narration (the start line and anything else), or result, picked by score like the grades (the first entry whose minimum the score reaches). Keep tags short and the tone dry: a long-suffering landlord, not melodrama. Changing a direction re-records that line on the next `npm run audio:generate`; `npm run audio:dry` shows every line as it will be sent.
